summary: One church. Weekend, weekday and confession times agree in both issues (image-only bulletins, read by render) and on the website. The end conflicts: both issues give 7:00 PM twice (p2 and the p6 Barron series 'at 7 PM after Exposition') against the website's 6:00 PM; leaning bulletin, as st-john-chrysostom-wallingford s10 kept the bulletin's end over the website.
